production_hotfix_authority.note: This is the production authority; the small repository real1298 snapshot must not be treated as equivalent.

implementation.real_progress: Manifest/download bytes, WASM compile, Emscripten dependency preparation, auth/game socket open, runtime init and first-controllable world-ready are separately recorded. No timer-driven progress bar is used.
implementation.world_ready_gate: Overlay closes only on oldkoweb:world-ready / oldkowebWorldReady, not on onRuntimeInitialized.
implementation.cache: Exact sha256+bytes+content-version URLs; Cache Storage retains active + previous versions; Range/206 is excluded; failures fall back to network; retry invalidates suspect current-version cache.
implementation.sensitive_data: Runtime worker explicitly bypasses /api/, /auth, /game, /admin and /account. No credentials, API responses or socket payloads are persisted.
implementation.wasm: instantiateStreaming is attempted and measured; ArrayBuffer fallback is explicit. No generated JS/WASM/data binary is manually patched.
implementation.asset_packaging: Exact-case /data VFS inputs; missing/case-mismatched asset fails the pack build. No black-model/placeholder substitution.
implementation.map_scope: Only verified startup assets are planned. Unrelated maps are excluded; full Moradon map split waits for authoritative VFS closure.

build_recipe: Extract the exact pinned production hotfix artifact without altering KnightOnLine.js/.wasm/.data.

For verified VFS packs run: python tools/p2-02/Build-OldKOWebAssetPacks.py --asset-root <data-root> --plan coordination/phase2/P2-02/asset-pack-plan.json --file-packager <emscripten/file_packager.py> --out <pack-out> --execute
P2-00/P2-12 compose the resulting shell/runtime/headers; P2-02 does not edit the shared build workflow or nginx.

blockers.detail: Exact live JS/WASM/data byte sizes and SHA256 cannot be read from this environment. The production artifact identity is pinned, and manifest generation is implemented, but integration must run it against the extracted 624650811-byte hotfix artifact before release.
No comparable target-PC/browser/network baseline exists yet; instrumentation and protocol are now provided.
Launcher intentionally remains visible until renderer/input emits the first-controllable-frame readiness event.
Pinned WS38 manifest verifies combat assets but not the complete Moradon startup/map file closure, so P2-02 refuses to guess a map pack.
WS12 contains hero-1299-hd.jpg and moradon-1299.jpg but no authoritative record that identifies the accepted original launcher artwork. moradon-1299.jpg is used only as an existing fallback.
Required MIME/cache/compression header contract is documented, but nginx is outside P2-02 ownership.
